# C4 update report

The frame and its rules are `../../resources/report-contract.md`. Follow this shape exactly.

```markdown
## C4 update · <owner/repo> · <YYYY-MM-DD>

**<Verdict: how many generated files moved, and the draft pull request.>**

### Needs you
| What | Where | Do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Review the refreshed model | [#<n>](<url>) | [files](<url>/files) |
| <An unmapped resource, a project in no block, a missing description or alias> | <file> | <the mapping, description, or alias to add> |

### Moved
| Level | File | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |

### Run
| Outcome | What | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |

*`schedule-c4-update@<version>` · <levels run> · <ISO datetime UTC>*
```

Nothing moved: the heading, `Nothing changed.`, *Needs you* when a report is open, and *Run*.
